value: maxWorkers required 1..2; TeamPlan.team max 2; UI only 1/2; dispatch serial
condition: plan proposes more than two total roles, not more than two active workers
effect: Schema rejects larger teams before dispatch. UI calls this concurrent workers although dispatch is serial.
recommendation: Split logical task/role count from active writer/inference capacity. Use incremental validated task decisions; retain one writer per shared worktree.
tests: Plan more than two sequential tasks while one writer stays active.
UI automatic value and profile round-trip; native/managed plan schema compatibility.

value: steps min 2, max 12
condition: one-step task or more than twelve plan steps
effect: Valid work can require artificial extra steps or fail schema.
recommendation: Make plan milestones incremental/versioned. Keep per-message size protections without a goal-wide step limit.
tests: Single coherent step and append of later milestones; no graph cycles or invalid owners.

value: maxRepairs required 0..2; default 2; UI 0/1/2
condition: final verification/review still fails after configured repair count
effect: Stops goal after finite corrections even if aggregate request quota is removed. 0 means no repair, not unlimited.
recommendation: Version optional user repair cap; default progress-aware strategy transitions. Keep every acceptance gate and unknown-effect handling.
tests: More than two improving repairs without explicit cap; explicit cap honored; mixed check/review failures share policy.

value: two plan attempts
effect: Stops before implementation, including role-reference/schema mistakes from small models.
recommendation: Return exact invalid field and permitted identifiers; adapt/replan on verified new information. Any total attempt ceiling should be user policy, not hidden default.
tests: Third valid correction under observation-only policy; repeated identical invalid proposal changes strategy; no authority expansion.

value: one automatic worker replan per run
condition: known scope-verified incomplete/context failure happens again
effect: A prior replan marker disables further automatic refinement; resuming does not restore allowance.
recommendation: Keep strict known-outcome/scope eligibility. Separate recovery correctness from optional total replan policy and track progress instead of a one-ever flag.
tests: Multiple distinct known failures preserve counters and criteria; unknown action still never replayed.

value: one nonterminal run per project
condition: start/resume while another run is nonterminal
effect: Rejects even independent worktrees/goals; not just one writer per worktree.
recommendation: Queue runs and schedule capacity independently of worktree writer leases.
tests: Concurrent separate goal worktrees; one writer on each; queued resume and cancellation.

value: project settings/research/verify/apply gated while run active; running goal cannot be edited
condition: user adjusts project profile/research/apply or running goal
effect: A new optional quota cannot be changed through existing profile save during an active run.
recommendation: Retain frozen run authority and CAS. Add explicit audited per-run resource-policy update; allow unrelated configuration revisions for later runs where safe.
tests: Update cap while active without changing write scope/checks; old attempt snapshots preserved; no action replay.

value: 600000 ms inactivity (10 minutes), overwritten on start/resume
configuredBy: hard-coded DEFAULT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS; no command field to disable
condition: no runtime progress signal for 10 minutes
effect: No total-time limit, but mandatory inactivity stop remains even if financial/request quotas disabled.
recommendation: Separate transport liveness from meaningful goal progress and user inactivity policy; preserve workspace and reconcile uncertain outcomes.
tests: Silent but live long tool; provider disconnect; resume keeps explicit user choice; token streaming is not semantic progress.

value: turnTimeoutMs accepts 10s..15min/default 360000 but execution passes run.timePolicy idle timeout
configuredBy: project profile snapshot versus actual turn dispatch
effect: Stored numeric setting is not the active production completed-turn timeout; actual default is 10min.
recommendation: Remove/rename dead field during versioned migration or wire explicit semantics; do not retain two misleading timeout settings.
tests: Set 20s and 15min then assert effective policy; old snapshot migration; UI shows actual effective value.

value: check timeout required 1s..15min; discovered check default 180000 ms
configuredBy: protected check profile; UI does not expose timeout field
condition: a check exceeds its configured wall time
effect: Owned process group is terminated; timeout exit -1 blocks acceptance.
recommendation: Keep configurable command health policy, independent of goal budget; expose current timeout and allow long trusted checks explicitly.
tests: Long active check; timeout/abort kills and reaps group; timeout is unavailable/failed evidence not code success.

value: saving setup regenerates commands with timeoutMs=300000
condition: user saves profile with setup text
effect: Existing per-setup timeout can be overwritten to five minutes.
recommendation: Preserve structured command IDs/timeouts on save; expose explicit timeout settings.
tests: Round-trip customized setup timeout without change; intentional new defaults only for new commands.

value: checkConcurrency optional 1..4/default1; UI offers1/2/4
effect: Controls active check workers, not total checks or goal lifetime.
recommendation: Retain capacity scheduling; consider capability-aware automatic concurrency. Do not interpret 0 as unlimited through ||1.
tests: Independent checks parallelize; shared-output checks remain serial; no extra total quota.

value: legacy NodeChecks sends SIGTERM after30000ms, no SIGKILL/reap deadline
condition: no profile uses NodeChecks fallback and script stalls/ignores SIGTERM
effect: Attempted timeout is not guaranteed termination; stdout/stderr accumulate without bounds.
recommendation: Use common owned-process executor, streaming artifacts and kill escalation; do not present30s as guaranteed full deadline.
tests: Trusted child ignoring SIGTERM; bounded cleanup; no unbounded in-memory log; managed profile route unaffected.

value: 24000 UTF-8 bytes for planning instructions plus brief
condition: full required brief/material metadata exceeds envelope
effect: Fails PLANNING_INPUT_TOO_LARGE before model call independently of actual model capacity.
recommendation: Construct versioned context views; page optional references while preserving required criteria; use model-aware admission.
tests: Large material library; long genuine criteria; no silent omission; physical admission versus conservative rejection differentiated.

value: 128KiB worker instructions+serialized envelope; internal maxBytes injection
configuredBy: helper default; production dispatch passes none
effect: Fails WORKER_ENVELOPE_TOO_LARGE without truncating requirements.
recommendation: Retain complete contract via artifact references/chunked views; avoid treating one payload size as total goal/work lifetime.
tests: Over128KiB references with recoverable paged evidence; required constraints not lost.

value: 2KiB total failed-check diagnostic allowance, <=1KiB each
effect: Only a short head/tail reaches worker; excerpt says complete log retained.
recommendation: Use retrievable versioned full log artifacts plus bounded focused excerpt.
tests: Many failures retain identifiers and first/last context; worker can request full selected diagnostic.

value: only final30000 characters of stdout+stderr survive
effect: Earlier output is discarded, contradicting complete-log-retained prompt markers.
recommendation: Stream complete/redacted log to private artifact; keep bounded tail/read range with explicit truncation and reference.
tests: Failure at beginning of >30k log remains retrievable; restart preserves log identity; no secrets leak.

value: checkContext output6000chars; planning max12check summaries, names120/error300/output480
effect: Excerpts and omitted-results count are bounded; not a run quota.
recommendation: Keep focused views but guarantee external full-artifact retrieval; do not mistake omitted diagnostics for omitted requirements.
tests: Omitted checks recorded; actual acceptance still evaluates every registered check; full log references resolve.

value: goal title200/body16000/criteria8000 chars; max32 material IDs
condition: large goal description or attachment selection
effect: Rejects or prevents input independently of resource quota.
recommendation: Keep bounded command envelopes; support attachment references/paged selection rather than unlimited text in one frame.
tests: UI and API agree; long requirements attached without silent field truncation; references retain provenance.

value: role title120/description1000/instructions16000; role ID pattern max64
effect: Can reject reusable role; huge accepted role instructions may exceed model context later.
recommendation: Retain identity/closed-schema guards; model-aware context packaging and references for large instructions.
tests: Role catalog references preserve exact constraints; invalid IDs never mapped silently to authority.

value: context16000chars; allowed/protected paths40each; checks8; setup4; components12
effect: Rejected profile even when execution resources are ample.
recommendation: Use stable references/paged collections and independently scheduled checks; per-command envelope caps remain explicit.
tests: More than8 logical checks or12 components via versioned profile; all registered checks still enforced.

value: objective/expectedResult2000chars; inputs16paths*512chars; criteria1..8*1000chars
condition: compact delegated task larger than schema
effect: Rejects assignment; coordinator input list cannot expand during current refinement.
recommendation: Keep coherent small task contracts but support multiple linked tasks/artifact refs; preserve all parent acceptance criteria.
tests: Long task contract split without weaker criteria; inputs remain authorized; no hidden total-work cap.

value: 8MiB/file,48MiB/import,64files/import,directory nesting12
effect: Fails CONTEXT_LIMIT; per-import capacity not model budget.
recommendation: Retain safe streaming/chunk limits; offer multiple/chunked imports and indexed references.
tests: Boundary sizes/depth; no partial unsafe writes; large batch pagination preserves files and provenance.

value: 64activeproject materials;1000libraryrecords includinginactive; goal references32
configuredBy: hard-coded library cap and command schema
condition: repeated imports/removals or large active project library
stopScope: project material library and run context
effect: Remove only sets active=false; GC does not prune material rows. Project metadata all enters every goal and can hit brief/envelope caps.
recommendation: Separate indexed library from selected context; page library and retain historical referenced versions; optional user storage policies rather than fixed lifetime record limit.
tests: Import/remove repeatedly past1000 with old-run replay; project context selects relevant references; material IDs remain stable.

value: PDF/DOCX extraction timeout30s, output buffer1MiB
effect: Import can succeed with unavailable extraction note; original binary remains but managed text reader may not consume it.
recommendation: Keep converter health bounds; streamed extraction with paged text and explicit incomplete-input status.
tests: Large PDF/document preserves source, partial/unavailable clearly labelled; no false claim material read.

value: WebSocket incoming max12MiB; uploadbase64 field max12MiB chars; decodedmaterial8MiB stricter
effect: Inbound frame rejected/connection closed; does not cap outbound snapshots.
recommendation: Retain frame protections; streaming/chunked upload and bounded command refs.
tests: 8MiBdecoded upload fits with JSON overhead; oversize typed error; no confusion with goal quota.

value: default15s; verify4h; probe135s; models20s; import180s; apply60s
effect: Client timeout removes pending request but does not prove server cancellation; retry path may use new command ID.
recommendation: Prefer job handles and receipt reconciliation; surface still-running/unknown response rather than imply action failed.
tests: Lost response then reconnect reconciles original command ID; side effects not duplicated; long import visible.

value: UIinitial connect8s; socket reconnect delay700ms
effect: May show connection failure while service work continues.
recommendation: Retain connectivity diagnostics and retries with backoff; separate UI transport state from durable goal state.
tests: Long snapshot replay; reconnect retains current goal and in-flight command identity.

value: beforeblob2MiB buffer; modifiedafterfile1MiB
effect: Legitimate large file modification can fail verification even with no model quota.
recommendation: Use full versioned blobs/stream hashes and paged review excerpts; never silently mark incomplete source as fully reviewed.
tests: Modify/delete large file; complete before/after integrity; diff/review retrieval and scope checks remain correct.

value: 32MiB Git stdout maxBuffer; someoperations1MiB
effect: Process can fail due buffer instead of task semantics.
recommendation: Stream/NUL-page metadata; separate full immutable artifact from UI output.
tests: Large path lists; binary names; cancellation and no partial accepted result.

value: environment recipe fingerprint max32MiB/10000files
condition: recipe points to very broad source/dependency tree
effect: Stops before setup; prevents expensive broad hashing but blocks overly broad valid recipe.
recommendation: Select exact toolchain inputs, content-addressed incremental hashes; retain symlink/privacy guards.
tests: Large genuine config with incremental hash; node_modules not accidentally selected; environment revisions invalidate correctly.

value: recipe inputs40, variables40*4000chars, setup8, ready1..8; eachcommand1s..15min
effect: Cannot represent large recipe in single response; reserved env-root replacement is forbidden separately.
recommendation: Use reusable versioned recipe steps/dependencies; retain reserved root and command authority protections.
tests: Long recipe split across saved phases; environment variables cannot override service roots.

value: Docker rejected when privateDataIsolation=true
condition: managed API model needs prepared private isolation but Docker selected
effect: UI permits choosing Docker although managed environment cannot supply required protection.
recommendation: Capability-aware UI/preflight and supported isolated Docker executor; do not bypass isolation to remove a limit.
tests: Ollama/DeepSeek Docker unavailable before inference; native supported mode unchanged; no host fallback.

value: preview readiness60s; HTTPprobe1s; poll300ms; shutdowngrace1200ms
effect: Preview fails before app eventually starts; shutdown forceskill aftergrace.
recommendation: Make readiness explicitly component-configurable; preserve owned cleanup and truthful unavailable state.
tests: Slow valid boot; stuck readiness; siblings shut down; user goal acceptance not falsely changed.

value: deploy command15min; postdeployHTTPverify15s
effect: Stops delivery or leaves external outcome needing reconciliation; cannot blindly retry.
recommendation: Explicit deployment policy/job reconciliation independent of coding quota.
tests: Remote effect completed despite lost response; no duplicate deployment; acceptedcode preserved.

value: no explicit run/history cap; full in-memory snapshot and history replay; GC onlyrepersists/state-temp cleanup
effect: Physical memory/latency becomes effective ceiling; outgoing snapshots are not protected by inbound frame limit.
recommendation: Paged read models, append-only event/artifact storage and incremental subscriptions; retain receipt/replay correctness.
tests: Large history/reconnect boundedmemory; gaps/duplicates absent; old accepted evidence still readable.

value: allowed/protected scope, nonoverlap, registeredchecks, freshreview, frozenCAS and unknown-outcome guards
condition: proposal/changes exceed ownership or requiredcheck/review missing
effect: Stops unauthorized or unverified work irrespective of usage policy.
recommendation: Retain. Observation-only quotas must not weaken authorization, protectedchecks, actual process observation or unknown-effect reconciliation.
tests: Unlimited policy still rejects out-ofscope/forged/stale evidence and unknown-action replay.
